chapter: Raymond Scott, Kirby and postwar bands
title: Tripling jobs: CBS show, Roxy Theatre and the Aquarium
summary: Leeman, Webster and Shavers do the radio show and four Roxy shows daily, then walk three blocks to the Aquarium until four in the morning.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: And in the interim, we went in there for about a month or two. Raymond Scott booked the Roxy Theatre and said we'll coincide our rehearsals and our CBS show, because the Roxy Theatre was right next door to ...

Right next door to where we did the CBS show. Now he's not figuring us with Kirby, that's the last thing in his mind, but he figured we could run from the theatre, we could run from the air show over to the theatre and do our shows.
CBS show was what we now call A&R recording studios -- 799 7th Avenue.

Right. So we did four -- three, no, four shows a day and five on Saturdays and Sundays at the Roxy Theatre. We were five days across the board. Weekdays we did the air show across the country, the radio show, and when I would come off from the Roxy Theatre -- the three of us -- Ben, Charlie and myself, we would walk down the street three blocks and go to work with John Kirby until four o'clock in the morning.
Let me tell you, we were doubling three jobs. This is really for the boobie hatch.
Yes sir; get my white coat ready!
